verdict.rationale: Warp's docs show that windows, tabs and panes are native constructs: they are restored automatically on relaunch, and separate agent conversations can run at once in different windows, tabs or panes. That points to built-in multiplexing with no need for tmux or similar, but the evidence only implies it in passing rather than documenting the feature. Missing for 10: dedicated docs on splitting panes (split directions, keybindings, resizing, navigation), tab management or organization features, and independent hands-on corroboration of pane and tab workflows.
